list.label: SCCM Database
list.description: Microsoft SQL Server data source for the Configuration Manager site database (CM_<site code>), with a read-only login. Chosen automatically if its name contains "SCCM", "ConfigMgr" or "Configuration Manager"; otherwise pick it here.

list.definition:
SELECT Name AS __text, CollectionID AS __value
FROM dbo.v_Collection
WHERE CollectionType = 2
ORDER BY Name
list.label: Collection
list.name: cmcoll
list.query:
SELECT Name AS __text, CollectionID AS __value
FROM dbo.v_Collection
WHERE CollectionType = 2
ORDER BY Name

title: SCCM - Software Updates

panels.description: Updates synchronised into the catalog that are not expired or superseded.

targets.rawSql:
WITH m AS (SELECT ResourceID FROM dbo.v_ClientCollectionMembers WHERE CollectionID = '${cmcoll}')
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.v_UpdateInfo WHERE IsExpired = 0 AND IsSuperseded = 0) AS [Updates in catalog],
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.v_UpdateInfo WHERE IsDeployed = 1) AS [Updates deployed],
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cs.CI_ID) FROM dbo.v_Update_ComplianceStatus cs JOIN m ON m.ResourceID = cs.ResourceID WHERE cs.Status = 2) AS [Updates needed],
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cs.ResourceID) FROM dbo.v_Update_ComplianceStatus cs JOIN m ON m.ResourceID = cs.ResourceID WHERE cs.Status = 2) AS [Devices missing updates],
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.v_Update_ComplianceStatus cs JOIN m ON m.ResourceID = cs.ResourceID WHERE cs.Status = 2 AND cs.LastErrorCode NOT IN (0, 4294967295)) AS [Installs with errors],
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cs.ResourceID) FROM dbo.v_Update_ComplianceStatus cs JOIN m ON m.ResourceID = cs.ResourceID) AS [Devices scanned]

panels.title: Devices scanned

panels.description: What the devices of the selected collection still miss, grouped by the vendor severity.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE u.Severity WHEN 10 THEN 'Critical' WHEN 8 THEN 'Important' WHEN 6 THEN 'Moderate' WHEN 2 THEN 'Low' ELSE 'Unspecified' END AS [Severity],
  COUNT(DISTINCT u.CI_ID) AS [Updates],
  COUNT(DISTINCT cs.ResourceID) AS [Devices],
  COUNT(*) AS [Missing installs]
FROM dbo.v_Update_ComplianceStatus cs
JOIN dbo.v_UpdateInfo u ON u.CI_ID = cs.CI_ID
JOIN dbo.v_ClientCollectionMembers m ON m.ResourceID = cs.ResourceID AND m.CollectionID = '${cmcoll}'
WHERE cs.Status = 2
GROUP BY u.Severity
ORDER BY u.Severity DESC

panels.title: Updates needed by severity

panels.description: Software update deployments and how many devices have installed, already had, miss or failed the updates.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  d.AssignmentName AS [Deployment],
  d.CollectionName AS [Collection],
  d.StartTime AS [Available from],
  d.NumTotal AS [Devices],
  d.NumInstalled AS [Installed],
  d.NumPresent AS [Already present],
  d.NumMissing AS [Missing],
  d.NumFailed AS [Failed],
  d.NumUnknown AS [Unknown],
  CASE WHEN d.NumTotal > 0 THEN CAST(100.0 * (d.NumInstalled + d.NumPresent + d.NumNotApplicable) / d.NumTotal AS decimal(5, 1)) END AS [Compliance %],
  d.LastSummaryTime AS [Last summarised]
FROM dbo.v_UpdateDeploymentSummary d
ORDER BY d.StartTime DESC

panels.title: Update deployments

panels.description: Devices of the selected collection with updates still to install.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 100
  s.Name0 AS [Device],
  SUM(CASE WHEN cs.Status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Updates needed],
  SUM(CASE WHEN cs.Status = 2 AND u.Severity = 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Critical needed],
  SUM(CASE WHEN cs.Status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Installed],
  SUM(CASE WHEN cs.Status = 2 AND cs.LastErrorCode NOT IN (0, 4294967295) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Installs with errors],
  MAX(cs.LastStatusCheckTime) AS [Last scan]
FROM dbo.v_Update_ComplianceStatus cs
JOIN dbo.v_UpdateInfo u ON u.CI_ID = cs.CI_ID
JOIN dbo.v_ClientCollectionMembers m ON m.ResourceID = cs.ResourceID AND m.CollectionID = '${cmcoll}'
JOIN dbo.v_R_System s ON s.ResourceID = cs.ResourceID
GROUP BY s.Name0
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN cs.Status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN cs.Status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC, s.Name0

panels.title: Devices missing the most updates

panels.description: The most recently released updates that are not expired or superseded.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 100
  u.DatePosted AS [Released],
  u.Title AS [Update],
  CASE u.Severity WHEN 10 THEN 'Critical' WHEN 8 THEN 'Important' WHEN 6 THEN 'Moderate' WHEN 2 THEN 'Low' ELSE 'Unspecified' END AS [Severity],
  u.ArticleID AS [Article],
  u.BulletinID AS [Bulletin],
  CASE WHEN u.IsDeployed = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS [Deployed]
FROM dbo.v_UpdateInfo u
WHERE u.IsExpired = 0 AND u.IsSuperseded = 0
ORDER BY u.DatePosted DESC
